title: Count range for PNG block length field
summary: The Length of PNG only counts Data, and a complete block occupies a total of Length + 12 bytes.
applies: PNG data stream; calculated from valid chunk starting point
detail: The four fields are 4-byte length, 4-byte type, variable-length data, and 4-byte CRC. The length is stored in big-endian order. The data length of IEND is zero, and the entire block still occupies 12 bytes.
boundary: The length field can only give the position of the claimed next block. This location may exceed the actual data when the file is truncated or the fields are corrupted.
relevance: When checking the block boundaries of PNG attachments, counting the type or CRC into the length will cause misalignment from the second block onwards.
